name: Scobe Booking Lite – Appointment Booking for Salons
author: Scobe Software

sections.description:
Let customers book salon appointments on your WordPress website. They choose a service and an available time; you manage appointments, staff and customer records from one dashboard.

Scobe Booking Lite is free, with unlimited staff members, services and appointments. It also includes email confirmations and records for payments you collect in person.

Included in the free plugin

  • Unlimited staff members, services, categories and appointments
  • Booking page with live availability, published for you by the setup wizard
  • Day-by-staff, week and month calendar for your team
  • Customer list built automatically from bookings, with visit history and private notes
  • Email confirmations for the customer and the business, with a calendar (.ics) file
  • Manual payment records: cash, card terminal, bank transfer or other
  • English, Turkish, German, Spanish and French

How customers book

  1. Choose a service (price and duration are shown).
  2. Pick a day, then an available time.
  3. Enter name and phone (email optional) and confirm.

The confirmation screen shows the service, date, time and price, and offers an “Add to calendar” file. The layout is made for phones first.

Set up your booking page

The setup wizard asks for your business details, your first staff member, shared business hours and your first service, then publishes a “Book an Appointment” page. You can also place the [scobe_booking_lite] shortcode on any page yourself. Until setup is finished, the plugin tells you exactly what is still missing.

Manual payment records

Record payments the business has already received outside the plugin:

  • Several payment records per appointment
  • Paid, partially paid or unpaid status with the remaining balance
  • Payments list with daily and monthly totals

These are records, not online payment processing. Scobe Booking Lite does not charge customers, connect to a payment gateway, or collect or store card numbers.

Private by design

All booking data stays in your own WordPress database. The plugin includes no telemetry or analytics and sends nothing to Scobe servers; see the Privacy section below.

Need more business tools?

Scobe Pro is a separate paid product with automatic SMS and WhatsApp reminders, individual working hours for each staff member, online payments, Google Calendar sync, product stock and expense tracking. Scobe Booking Lite remains free and works on its own; Pro feature code is not included in Lite.

External services

Scobe Booking Lite does not independently connect to Scobe servers or transmit booking data to an external Scobe service.

E-mail notifications use WordPress wp_mail() and the site’s configured mail system. The site’s hosting company, SMTP service or e-mail provider may therefore process message contents according to the site’s own configuration.

Privacy

Appointment, customer, staff, service, manual payment and plugin settings data are stored in the site’s WordPress database.

Scobe Booking Lite:

  • Does not independently transmit this data to Scobe servers
  • Does not include telemetry or analytics
  • Does not collect or store payment-card data
  • Stores payment entries only as manual operational records
  • Uses WordPress wp_mail() for notifications
  • Keeps historical customer, service and price snapshots in appointment records
  • Keeps cancelled appointments and their manual payment records
  • Does not automatically delete plugin tables or settings on deactivation or uninstall

E-mail messages can contain appointment and customer information. Hosting, SMTP and e-mail providers configured by the site may process those messages. Downloaded ICS files can contain appointment information and may be imported into a calendar service chosen by the user.

The public booking rate limiter stores a short-lived counter under a one-way keyed hash derived from the visitor’s validated network address. It does not place the raw address in the transient key. Only the server-provided REMOTE_ADDR is trusted by default. Sites behind a trusted reverse proxy may use the Lite-specific scblite_rate_limit_client_ip filter to return a validated client address; the site owner is responsible for configuring that trust boundary safely.

Appointment records keep customer, service and price snapshots so historical bookings remain understandable after related records change. Site owners are responsible for choosing an appropriate retention period and for deletion or anonymisation required by their published privacy policy and applicable law. Scobe Booking Lite also adds suggested text to the WordPress Privacy Policy Guide.

Third-party libraries

The admin calendar uses FullCalendar version 6.1.21 (https://fullcalendar.io/), MIT licensed. The bundled build is included at assets/js/vendor/fullcalendar/index.global.min.js; source is available at https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Scobe Booking Lite from the Plugins screen.
  2. Follow the setup wizard: business details, first staff member and shared business hours, first service.
  3. Let the wizard publish the booking page, or add the [scobe_booking_lite] shortcode to a page and publish it.
  4. Open the booking page in a private browser window and make a test booking. Check that it appears in Scobe Booking → Calendar and that the confirmation emails arrive.
  5. The shortcode is always available under Scobe Booking → Settings → Booking Form.
sections.faq:
What is included in the free version?

Lite includes unlimited staff members, services, categories and appointments, plus a booking page, an appointment calendar, customer records, email confirmations and manual payment records. Scobe Pro is not required.

Does the plugin take online payments?

No. It does not charge a customer or connect to an online payment gateway. It records payments collected separately by the business, such as cash, an in-person card terminal payment or a bank transfer.

How do I add the booking form to a page?

Let the setup wizard publish a booking page for you, or add a Shortcode block with [scobe_booking_lite] to any page and publish it. The shortcode is always available under Scobe Booking → Settings → Booking Form.

How do working hours work?

Set the shared business hours under Scobe Booking → Staff → Working Hours. They apply to all staff members. Closed dates and holiday ranges, managed on the same screen, block bookings for those days entirely.

Can I have several staff members?

Yes, staff members are unlimited. When two or more staff members are active, customers can choose who they book with, and each staff member’s existing appointments are respected.

Which currency is used?

You choose the business currency in the setup wizard or under Settings. It is shown with every price and payment.

Does it store card information?

No. “Physical card/POS” only identifies how an external in-person payment was received. No card number, security code or other card credential is collected or stored.

Does it contact external servers?

No. Booking runs entirely on your own site, there is no telemetry, and emails go through your own WordPress mail system.

What happens to my data if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivation and uninstall keep appointments, customers, services, payments and settings in the database so nothing is lost unexpectedly. You can remove the data yourself if you no longer need it.

Which languages are supported?

English, Turkish, German, Spanish and French translations are bundled. The booking form language can be set separately from the admin language under Settings.

Is Scobe Pro required?

No. Scobe Booking Lite is a standalone free plugin. Scobe Pro is a separate paid product.

Can Lite and Pro be active at the same time?

Yes. Use [scobe_booking_lite] for the Lite booking form. When Pro is active, Lite does not register the legacy [scobe_booking] alias, leaving that shortcode to Pro.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Calendar: a calmer toolbar in one row. Arrows for previous and next, the date box jumps as soon as a date is picked, and the staff filter only appears when there are two or more staff members.
  • Calendar: confirmed appointments in the day-by-staff view now use each staff member’s colour.
  • Appointment page: action buttons have one consistent style; “Add to calendar” got an icon.

1.0.3

  • Booking form: no more empty dark area above the form on phones; larger inputs so phones do not zoom in.
  • Booking form: prices are shown with the business currency, the time shows start and end, and the day is no longer chosen for the customer.
  • Booking form: the details step shows a review of the appointment, required fields are marked, and going back keeps the chosen time.
  • Booking form: the confirmation shows the service, date, time and price; the “Add to calendar” file now uses the same time zone handling as the email attachment.
  • Emails: confirmations include the end time, price and staff member, and customers can reply to reach the business. Business notifications include the customer’s note.
  • Setup: the dashboard only says the booking page is live after checking staff, service and a published page. Unfinished setup shows a “Continue setup” link on Scobe Booking screens and on the WordPress dashboard (dismissible there).
  • Setup wizard: clearer texts, shared business hours explained, a copy button for the shortcode, and the last step opens the booking page for a test booking.
  • Admin: “Collections” is now “Payments” and the appointment page is “Appointment & payments”. The appointment list shows payment status, has search and a “Record payment” shortcut.
  • Admin: payment method must be chosen before saving a payment; a “Mark as no-show” action was added.
  • Admin: Services and Staff open on their lists; the calendar explains weekly closed days; customers show last visit and next appointment separately.
  • Fixed: saving a staff member from the list no longer erases their phone number.
  • Fixed: the second page of a customer’s appointment history opened a missing page.
  • New installs: Monday to Saturday are open by default and the currency follows the site language.

1.0.2

  • Fixed the setup wizard’s “Skip this step”, “Keep current staff member” and “Use existing service” buttons, which did nothing while the step’s required fields were empty.

1.0.1

  • Fixed a first-run setup condition that could leave the public booking page unavailable after onboarding.
  • The booking form now shows a clear closed state when nothing is bookable yet, with setup shortcuts visible only to administrators.
  • Improved compatibility with theme-level button and form-control resets.
  • Improved calendar presentation on very narrow mobile screens.
  • Fixed localization of the Pending appointment status.
  • Fixed display of legacy card payment methods in translated interfaces.
  • Improved localized fallback handling for unexpected status and payment values.
  • Fixed a fatal error when the plugin was activated with older WP-CLI versions.
  • Refreshed bundled translation catalogs.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: stepped front-end booking form, staff day/week/month calendar, appointments, customer directory, services, weekly hours and closed dates, manual payment records, e-mail confirmations and .ics downloads.
